name: One Love Animal Hospital

region_note: EMERGENCIES BY DAY - vet practices that see emergencies and urgent problems during opening hours but are NOT open overnight. From the Mayor's Alliance emergency vet list; each checked on its own site 2026-11-03. At night, use a 24/7 hospital above.
